ab-wheel-rollout-knees.cue: From the knees. Brace hard, stop before the back arches.

band-assisted-pull-ups.cue: Band under the knees or feet. Full hang, chin over the bar.

bayesian-cable-curl.cue: Face away from a low cable, arm behind the body. Curl from the stretch.

bicycle-crunch.cue: Slow. Opposite elbow to knee, other leg long.

bird-dog.cue: Reach the opposite arm and leg long. Pause 2 sec, hips level.

bird-dog-plank-hybrid.cue: From a high plank, lift the opposite arm and leg. No twist.

bulgarian-split-squat-dbs.cue: Rear foot on the bench. Upright torso, drop straight down.

cable-crunch.cue: Kneel, rope by the ears. Crunch down, rounding the upper spine.

cable-curl-drop-set.cue: Elbows pinned, stand tall. Curl to the chest, lower slowly.

cable-lateral-raise.cue: Cable behind the body. Lead with the elbow to shoulder height.

cable-overhead-extension.cue: Face away from a low pulley. Elbows by the ears, stretch, extend.

chest-supported-db-row.cue: Chest on the bench. Pull to the hips, pause and squeeze at the top.

close-grip-lat-pulldown.cue: Neutral handle. Full stretch at the top, elbows to ribs.

copenhagen-plank.cue: Top leg on the bench, side plank on the forearm. Hips high.

db-bench-press.cue: Feet planted. Lower deep, press up and slightly in.

db-lateral-raise.cue: Lead with the elbows to shoulder height. No swing.

dead-bug.cue: Low back pressed down. Reach the opposite arm and leg out, switch.

ez-bar-skull-crusher.cue: Lower behind the head for more stretch. Elbows stay in.

face-pulls.cue: Rope to the eyebrows, elbows high, pull the ends apart.

glute-bridge-with-hold.cue: On your back, feet flat. Squeeze the glutes 3 sec at the top.

hammer-curl.cue: Thumbs up, elbows at the sides. No swing.

hanging-knee-to-elbow-twist.cue: Hang still. Knees up and across toward the opposite elbow.

hanging-leg-raise.cue: No swinging. Raise the legs, curl the pelvis toward the ribs.

hip-thrust.cue: Upper back on the bench. Pause 2 sec at the top, chin tucked.

hollow-body-hold.cue: Low back flat, arms overhead, legs low. Bend the knees if it lifts.

incline-db-curl.cue: 45° bench, arms hang behind the body. Slow 3-second lower.

incline-db-press.cue: 30° bench. Deep stretch at the bottom, drive up.

l-sit-progression.cue: Shoulders pushed down, legs level. Tuck the knees if you must.

leg-extension.cue: Sit back, pad on the shins. Squeeze 1 sec at the top.

leg-press.cue: Feet mid-plate. Stop before the hips lift off the pad.

low-to-high-cable-fly.cue: Pulleys low. Sweep the hands up and together to chin height.

lying-hamstring-curl.cue: Hips pressed down. Curl up, 3-second lower.

machine-chest-press.cue: Handles at mid-chest. Press out, control the way back.

machine-chest-press-or-flat-bench.cue: Handles at mid-chest. Press out, control the way back.

machine-shoulder-press.cue: Back supported. Two seconds down, stop just above the shoulders.

max-rep-set.cue: Strict: full hang, chin over the bar. Crisp reps, never grinding.

overhead-cable-extension.cue: Face away from a low pulley. Elbows by the ears, stretch, extend.

pallof-press.cue: Stand side-on. Press straight out and back, resist the twist.

preacher-curl.cue: Armpits on the pad. Full stretch at the bottom, no bounce.

reverse-pec-deck.cue: Chest on the pad. Sweep back to the sides, squeeze the rear delts.

rope-pushdown.cue: Elbows pinned to the ribs. Spread the rope at the bottom.

russian-twist-weighted.cue: Lean back 45°, feet up, plate at the chest. Rotate slowly.

seated-db-shoulder-press.cue: Back on the bench, no arching. Lower to ear level, press up.

side-plank-with-reach.cue: Side plank. Reach the top arm under and through, then to the ceiling.

single-arm-cable-row.cue: Stretch forward, then pull the elbow to the hip.

standing-calf-raise.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, 2-sec pause, rise high.

straight-arm-pulldown.cue: Arms straight, slight hinge. Sweep the bar to the thighs.

suitcase-carry.cue: One heavy DB at one side. Walk tall without leaning, then switch.

superman-hold.cue: Face down. Lift arms and legs a little, hold 3 sec. Look at the floor.

toe-touches.cue: Legs straight up. Reach for the toes, shoulders off the floor.

volume-sets.cue: Strict: full hang, chin over the bar. Crisp reps, never grinding.

weighted-plank.cue: Forearms down, plate on the upper back. Glutes tight, no sag.

weighted-pull-ups.cue: Dip belt. Full hang, chin over the bar.
